correctness.rationale: The Gram operator F*F has top-left projection V1V1*, off-diagonal V1T and lower diagonal I+T*T; conjugating V1H1⊕ker V1* separates 0_E and the shear Gram G*G. Polar decomposition of T splits ker T*, ker T and K=(ker T)^⊥, reducing the nontrivial part to the commuting positive block [[I,S],[S,I+S²]]. The stated continuous 2×2 unitary W(s) diagonalizes this exactly for all s>=0, yielding unitary |F| normal form with φ(S),φ(S)^−1 and exact exceptional eigenspace multiplicities. At λ≠1 Schur complement reduces Fredholmness to (1−λ²)²/λ²−T*T; at λ=1 the off-diagonal [[0,T],[T*,0]] is Fredholm iff T is Fredholm; infinite ker V1* adds essential 0. Thus the full essential spectrum and Schatten p criteria follow for arbitrary bounded T and two isometries. Independently checked eigenvalues of scalar blocks s=0,.25,1,4 and inspected finite matrix checker for all rectangular ranks; finite data do not establish infinite theorem.
